name: coutreach-lead-model
description: Prospect marketing, the lead model (rulings 41-50): CProspect gains leadStatus, leadStatusChangedAt and leadSource; its side exits gain Duplicate; Contact and Account stages gain Prospect and Engaged. Additive only - the old options and fields stay until the removal step (coutreach-lead-model-crm-handoff.md section 6).

fields.name: leadStatus
fields.label: Lead status
fields.tooltipText: Unqualified until a website or email shows it could become a client, partner or funder; Disqualified if it never will; Converted once first contact created its Company or Contact (rulings 42, 43).

fields.name: leadSource
fields.label: Lead Source
fields.tooltipText: Where the lead came from (ruling 41). The five public forms, event registration and the info mailbox are listed so a public-form arrival records its form (ruling 48).
